dialog.subCreate: Create a profile for a new agent. Saving starts a terminal session.
dialog.subEdit: Edit the profile. Changes apply as soon as you save.

identity.name: Name
identity.personalityHint: Describe who this character is. It is appended to Claude Code's system prompt and also feeds the portrait prompt and the character's speech style. Multiple lines are kept as written.
identity.archetypeHint: Sets the sprite's body type and outfit family. With “Auto (seed)” the seed decides. Typing a species that is not on the list (a dragon, say) carries straight into the portrait and pixel-art prompts, while the dot character is drawn with a human body.

appearance.manualHint: Copy the prompt into the image generator of your choice, then upload the result — the crop editor fits it to spec.
appearance.saveFirstHint: Save first, then upload images from the edit dialog.

keyColor.label: Key colors
keyColor.hint: These exact colors go into the portrait, sprite, and minimi prompts, and into the office-view character. Click a swatch to pick a color yourself; colors you leave alone follow the seed and archetype whenever those change.
keyColor.chipTitle: {{name}} approximately {{hex}} — click to pick a color

portrait.label: Portrait
portrait.requestHint: Appended to the portrait prompt only.

sprite.label: Sprite
sprite.customBadge: Using a custom sprite — regenerating does not change it
sprite.requestPlaceholder: e.g. a wizard in a red cloak (optional)
sprite.requestHint: Carried into both the copied sprite prompt and Codex generation.
sprite.transparentToggle: Make background transparent (by top-left pixel color)
sprite.sheetNote: Recognized as a 4-frame sheet. It is saved at the original cell resolution.
sprite.tooLarge: Encoding the image failed, or it exceeds the 1MiB limit.

minimi.label: Minimi
minimi.emptyBadge: None set — the sprite is scaled down instead
minimi.requestPlaceholder: e.g. a small flame spirit (optional; if empty, one matching the character is requested automatically)
minimi.requestHint: The minimi is the familiar that pops up beside the character's head while a subagent works. Leave it empty and the prompt automatically asks for a familiar that suits the character's look and role.
minimi.sheetNote: Recognized as a 4-frame sheet. The minimi uses only the first frame (idle0).
minimi.singleFrameNote: The minimi uses this single image as is, with no walk or breathing animation.

terminal.cwdPlaceholder: Empty means the home directory (you can type or paste a path)
terminal.startupCommandPlaceholder: e.g. source ./init.sh or mysetup.bat (optional, runs in every new terminal)
terminal.startupCommandHint: Runs automatically every time a new terminal session opens.
terminal.keyboardSoundHint: The sound this agent makes while typing. Picking one plays a preview.
terminal.talkReceiveHint: Turn this off and no other character can talk to this one. (It only matters while Coworker chat is on under Settings → Control.)
terminal.tmuxHostHint: When on, new sessions launch as a tmux session and the app just attaches to it. The profile's shell choice becomes moot (the pane shell is whatever the system default is). macOS/Linux only.

bot.sectionHint: Right-click the terminal tab → “Start bot mode” and this character reacts to slash commands posted on its repository's Gitea issues, working on them automatically. The settings below persist for the bot.
bot.slugPlaceholder: e.g. nova (optional; derived from the name when empty)
bot.slugHint: Call this character from an issue with /alias. Leave it empty to derive one from the name (spaces removed, lowercased).
bot.whitelistPlaceholder: Extra allowed Gitea accounts, comma separated (optional)
bot.whitelistHint: Accounts allowed to trigger commands. The logged-in tea account is always included.

voice.label: Voice (TTS)
voice.hintDisabled: Turn on ‘Read notification lines aloud (TTS)’ in Settings to choose a voice.
voice.hintEnabled: Leave it empty and a voice is chosen automatically from the character's species and seed.
voice.mutedNote: Mute is on, so real notifications are not spoken (previews still are).
voice.keyMissing: Save an ElevenLabs API key in Settings to choose a voice.
voice.listFailed: Could not load the voice list: {{error}}

codex.generated: Done — check it in the editor and save.
codex.unavailable: Could not find the codex CLI. Install it, log in, and reopen this tab.
codex.saveFirstHint: Save first, then generate from the edit dialog.
codex.hint: This uses the local codex CLI's image generation as is. One image usually takes 1–3 minutes and draws down your Codex usage. The result opens in the crop editor for you to review before saving.
codex.errNotFound: Could not find the codex CLI. Install it and try again.
codex.errTimeout: Generation did not finish in time. Try again.
codex.errNoOutput: codex did not save an image. Try again: {{detail}}

archetype.placeholder: Auto (seed) — you can also type a species that is not listed
archetype.customNote: Species not on the list — used verbatim in the art request; the dot character uses a human body.

color.title: Pick a {{label}} color
color.resetTitle: Revert to {{hex}}, the default the seed chose

editor.readFailed: Could not read that image. Choose a different file.
editor.generatedReadFailed: Could not read the generated image.
